+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if self.max_absolute is None and self.max_basis_points is None:
+            raise ValueError("at least one spread maximum is required")
+        _optional_nonnegative(self.max_absolute, "max_absolute")
+        _optional_nonnegative(self.max_basis_points, "max_basis_points")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class LiquidityFilter:
+    minimum_recent_volume: Decimal | None = None
+    minimum_quote_size: Decimal | None = None
+    max_quote_age: timedelta = timedelta(seconds=5)
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if self.minimum_recent_volume is None and self.minimum_quote_size is None:
+            raise ValueError("at least one liquidity minimum is required")
+        _optional_nonnegative(self.minimum_recent_volume, "minimum_recent_volume")
+        _optional_nonnegative(self.minimum_quote_size, "minimum_quote_size")
+        if not isinstance(self.max_quote_age, timedelta) or self.max_quote_age < timedelta(0):
+            raise ValueError("max_quote_age must be a non-negative timedelta")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class MarketFilterDecision:
+    allowed: bool
+    reasons: tuple[MarketFilterReason, ...]
+    evaluated_at: datetime
+    feed_provenance: str | None
+    spread_absolute: Decimal | None = None
+    spread_basis_points: Decimal | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def blocked(self) -> bool:
+        return not self.allowed
+
+    @classmethod
+    def evaluate(
+        cls, *, now: datetime, quote: QuoteSnapshot | None,
+        spread_filter: SpreadFilter | None = None,
+        liquidity_filter: LiquidityFilter | None = None,
+        recent_volume: Decimal | None = None,
+    ) -> "MarketFilterDecision":
+        return _evaluate_market_filters(
+            now=now, quote=quote, spread_filter=spread_filter,
+            liquidity_filter=liquidity_filter, recent_volume=recent_volume,
+        )
+
+
+def _evaluate_market_filters(
+    *, now: datetime, quote: QuoteSnapshot | None, spread_filter: SpreadFilter | None = None,
+    liquidity_filter: LiquidityFilter | None = None, recent_volume: Decimal | None = None,
+) -> MarketFilterDecision:
+    """Evaluate supplied data only; this function never fetches or persists anything."""
+    instant = _utc(now, "now")
+    if spread_filter is not None and not isinstance(spread_filter, SpreadFilter):
+        raise TypeError("spread_filter must be SpreadFilter or None")
+    if liquidity_filter is not None and not isinstance(liquidity_filter, LiquidityFilter):
+        raise TypeError("liquidity_filter must be LiquidityFilter or None")
+    if recent_volume is not None:
+        _nonnegative(recent_volume, "recent_volume")
+    reasons: list[MarketFilterReason] = []
+    provenance = None if quote is None else getattr(quote, "feed_id", None)
+    if quote is None:
+        reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_MISSING)
+    else:
+        if not isinstance(provenance, str) or not provenance.strip():
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.UNKNOWN_PROVENANCE)
+            provenance = None
+        else:
+            provenance = provenance.strip()
+        bid, ask = getattr(quote, "bid", None), getattr(quote, "ask", None)
+        receive_ts = getattr(quote, "receive_ts", None)
+        stale = getattr(quote, "stale", False)
+        if not isinstance(bid, Decimal) or not isinstance(ask, Decimal) or not bid.is_finite() or not ask.is_finite():
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.INVALID_QUOTE)
+        elif bid < _ZERO or ask < _ZERO:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.INVALID_QUOTE)
+        elif bid > ask:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_CROSSED)
+        elif bid == ask:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_LOCKED)
+        if not isinstance(receive_ts, datetime) or receive_ts.tzinfo is None or receive_ts.utcoffset() is None:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_STALE)
+        elif receive_ts.astimezone(timezone.utc) > instant or stale:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_STALE)
+        elif liquidity_filter is not None and instant - receive_ts.astimezone(timezone.utc) > liquidity_filter.max_quote_age:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_STALE)
+        spread_abs = spread_bps = None
+        if isinstance(bid, Decimal) and isinstance(ask, Decimal) and bid.is_finite() and ask.is_finite() and ask > bid and bid >= _ZERO:
+            spread_abs = ask - bid
+            midpoint = (ask + bid) / Decimal("2")
+            if midpoint > _ZERO:
+                spread_bps = spread_abs / midpoint * _TEN_THOUSAND
+            if spread_filter is not None:
+                if spread_filter.max_absolute is not None and spread_abs > spread_filter.max_absolute:
+                    reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.SPREAD_TOO_WIDE)
+                if spread_filter.max_basis_points is not None and (
+                    spread_bps is None or spread_bps > spread_filter.max_basis_points
+                ):
+                    reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.SPREAD_TOO_WIDE)
+        if liquidity_filter is not None:
+            if liquidity_filter.minimum_recent_volume is not None and (
+                recent_volume is None or recent_volume < liquidity_filter.minimum_recent_volume
+            ):
+                reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY)
+            if liquidity_filter.minimum_quote_size is not None:
+                bid_size, ask_size = getattr(quote, "bid_size", None), getattr(quote, "ask_size", None)
+                if (
+                    not isinstance(bid_size, Decimal) or not isinstance(ask_size, Decimal)
+                    or bid_size < liquidity_filter.minimum_quote_size
+                    or ask_size < liquidity_filter.minimum_quote_size
+                ):
+                    reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY)
+    unique_reasons = tuple(dict.fromkeys(reasons))
+    return MarketFilterDecision(
+        allowed=not unique_reasons, reasons=unique_reasons, evaluated_at=instant,
+        feed_provenance=provenance,
+        spread_absolute=spread_abs if quote is not None else None,
+        spread_basis_points=spread_bps if quote is not None else None,
+    )
+
+
+def _nonnegative(value: object, name: str) -> None:
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be Decimal")
+    if not value.is_finite() or value < _ZERO:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite and non-negative")
+
+
+def _optional_nonnegative(value: Decimal | None, name: str) -> None:
+    if value is not None:
+        _nonnegative(value, name)
+
+
+def _utc(value: datetime, name: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be timezone-aware UTC")
+    if value.utcoffset() != timedelta(0):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must use UTC")
+    return value.astimezone(timezone.utc)

+"""Pure NYSE session entry and discretionary minimum-hold policies."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from enum import Enum
+
+from mike_trade.scheduling import calendar
+
+__all__ = [
+    "SessionPolicy", "SessionDecision", "EntryCutoffPolicy",
+    "MinimumHoldPolicy", "ExitKind",
+]
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class SessionDecision:
+    allowed: bool
+    reason: str
+    evaluated_at: datetime
+    cutoff_at: datetime | None = None
+    hold_until: datetime | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def blocked(self) -> bool:
+        return not self.allowed
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class EntryCutoffPolicy:
+    """Stop accepting entries this many minutes before the actual session close."""
+
+    minutes_before_close: int = 0
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if isinstance(self.minutes_before_close, bool) or not isinstance(self.minutes_before_close, int):
+            raise TypeError("minutes_before_close must be an integer")
+        if self.minutes_before_close < 0:
+            raise ValueError("minutes_before_close must be non-negative")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class SessionPolicy:
+    """Regular-hours-only entry gate; end-of-day position closing is opt-in metadata."""
+
+    entry_cutoff: EntryCutoffPolicy | None = None
+    regular_hours_only: bool = True
+    end_of_day_close_enabled: bool = False
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if self.entry_cutoff is not None and not isinstance(self.entry_cutoff, EntryCutoffPolicy):
+            raise TypeError("entry_cutoff must be EntryCutoffPolicy or None")
+        if not isinstance(self.regular_hours_only, bool):
+            raise TypeError("regular_hours_only must be bool")
+        if not isinstance(self.end_of_day_close_enabled, bool):
+            raise TypeError("end_of_day_close_enabled must be bool")
+
+    def evaluate(self, now: datetime) -> SessionDecision:
+        instant = _utc(now, "now")
+        status = calendar.session_status(instant)
+        if self.regular_hours_only and status is not calendar.SessionStatus.REGULAR:
+            return SessionDecision(False, "OUTSIDE_REGULAR_HOURS", instant)
+        cutoff_at = None
+        if self.entry_cutoff is not None:
+            local_day = instant.astimezone(calendar.NEW_YORK).date()
+            if status is calendar.SessionStatus.REGULAR:
+                session = calendar.session_for(local_day)
+                cutoff_at = calendar.entry_cutoff(session, self.entry_cutoff.minutes_before_close)
+                if instant >= cutoff_at:
+                    return SessionDecision(False, "ENTRY_CUTOFF_REACHED", instant, cutoff_at)
+        return SessionDecision(True, "ALLOWED", instant, cutoff_at)
+
+
+class ExitKind(str, Enum):
+    STRATEGY = "strategy"
+    PROTECTIVE_STOP = "protective_stop"
+    TRAILING_STOP = "trailing_stop"
+    RISK_SAFETY = "risk_safety"
+    DAILY_LOSS = "daily_loss"
+    MANUAL_CLOSE = "manual_close"
+    CLOSE_ALL = "close_all"
+    FLATTEN = "flatten"
+    RECONCILIATION = "reconciliation"
+    END_OF_DAY = "end_of_day"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class MinimumHoldPolicy:
+    """Hold duration applies only to ordinary strategy SELL exits."""
+
+    minimum_hold: timedelta = timedelta(0)
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not isinstance(self.minimum_hold, timedelta) or self.minimum_hold < timedelta(0):
+            raise ValueError("minimum_hold must be a non-negative timedelta")
+
+    def evaluate(
+        self, *, now: datetime, first_confirmed_entry_fill_at: datetime | None,
+        exit_kind: ExitKind,
+    ) -> SessionDecision:
+        instant = _utc(now, "now")
+        if not isinstance(exit_kind, ExitKind):
+            raise TypeError("exit_kind must be ExitKind")
+        # All non-strategy exits are explicitly exempt from this discretionary policy.
+        if exit_kind is not ExitKind.STRATEGY or self.minimum_hold == timedelta(0):
+            return SessionDecision(True, "ALLOWED", instant)
+        if first_confirmed_entry_fill_at is None:
+            return SessionDecision(False, "NO_CONFIRMED_ENTRY_FILL", instant)
+        filled_at = _utc(first_confirmed_entry_fill_at, "first_confirmed_entry_fill_at")
+        hold_until = filled_at + self.minimum_hold
+        if instant < hold_until:
+            return SessionDecision(False, "MINIMUM_HOLD_NOT_ELAPSED", instant, hold_until=hold_until)
+        return SessionDecision(True, "ALLOWED", instant, hold_until=hold_until)
+
+
+def _utc(value: datetime, name: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a timezone-aware UTC datetime")
+    if value.utcoffset() != timedelta(0):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must use UTC")
+    return value.astimezone(timezone.utc)

+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+import pytest
+
+from mike_trade.risk.market_filters import (
+    LiquidityFilter,
+    MarketFilterDecision,
+    MarketFilterReason,
+    SpreadFilter,
+)
+from mike_trade.risk.session_policy import (
+    EntryCutoffPolicy,
+    ExitKind,
+    MinimumHoldPolicy,
+    SessionPolicy,
+)
+
+UTC = timezone.utc
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Quote:
+    bid: Decimal = Decimal("99.90")
+    ask: Decimal = Decimal("100.10")
+    bid_size: Decimal | None = Decimal("20")
+    ask_size: Decimal | None = Decimal("20")
+    receive_ts: datetime = datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
+    feed_id: str | None = "IEX"
+    stale: bool = False
+
+
+def test_regular_hours_gate_uses_new_york_dst_session_boundaries():
+    policy = SessionPolicy()
+    # DST began on March 9, 2025; Monday's regular open is now 13:30 UTC.
+    assert not policy.evaluate(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 13, 29, tzinfo=UTC)).allowed
+    assert policy.evaluate(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 13, 30, tzinfo=UTC)).allowed
+    assert not policy.evaluate(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 20, 0, tzinfo=UTC)).allowed
+
+
+def test_cutoff_uses_actual_early_close_time():
+    policy = SessionPolicy(entry_cutoff=EntryCutoffPolicy(30))
+    # Nov 28, 2025 is the day after Thanksgiving and closes at 13:00 ET.
+    assert policy.evaluate(datetime(2025, 11, 28, 17, 29, tzinfo=UTC)).allowed
+    blocked = policy.evaluate(datetime(2025, 11, 28, 17, 30, tzinfo=UTC))
+    assert blocked.reason == "ENTRY_CUTOFF_REACHED"
+    assert blocked.cutoff_at == datetime(2025, 11, 28, 17, 30, tzinfo=UTC)
+
+
+def test_market_filter_blocks_absolute_and_basis_point_spread():
+    now = datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
+    quote = Quote()
+    absolute = MarketFilterDecision.evaluate(
+        now=now, quote=quote, spread_filter=SpreadFilter(max_absolute=Decimal("0.10"))
+    )
+    assert MarketFilterReason.SPREAD_TOO_WIDE in absolute.reasons
+    bps = MarketFilterDecision.evaluate(
+        now=now, quote=quote, spread_filter=SpreadFilter(max_basis_points=Decimal("10"))
+    )
+    assert MarketFilterReason.SPREAD_TOO_WIDE in bps.reasons
+
+
+def test_market_filter_blocks_insufficient_liquidity_and_preserves_feed():
+    now = datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
+    decision = MarketFilterDecision.evaluate(
+        now=now, quote=Quote(),
+        liquidity_filter=LiquidityFilter(
+            minimum_recent_volume=Decimal("1000"), minimum_quote_size=Decimal("30")
+        ),
+        recent_volume=Decimal("999"),
+    )
+    assert MarketFilterReason.INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY in decision.reasons
+    assert decision.feed_provenance == "IEX"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("quote", "now", "reason"),
+    [
+        (None, datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC), MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_MISSING),
+        (Quote(receive_ts=datetime(2025, 3, 10, 13, 59, tzinfo=UTC)), datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC), MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_STALE),
+        (Quote(bid=Decimal("100.2"), ask=Decimal("100.1")), datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC), MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_CROSSED),
+        (Quote(bid=Decimal("100.1"), ask=Decimal("100.1")), datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC), MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_LOCKED),
+        (Quote(feed_id=None), datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC), MarketFilterReason.UNKNOWN_PROVENANCE),
+    ],
+)
+def test_market_filter_fails_closed_for_unusable_quote(quote, now, reason):
+    decision = MarketFilterDecision.evaluate(
+        now=now, quote=quote,
+        liquidity_filter=LiquidityFilter(minimum_quote_size=Decimal("1")),
+    )
+    assert not decision.allowed
+    assert reason in decision.reasons
+
+
+def test_minimum_hold_blocks_strategy_exit_until_elapsed():
+    policy = MinimumHoldPolicy(timedelta(minutes=10))
+    fill_at = datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
+    before = policy.evaluate(
+        now=fill_at + timedelta(minutes=9), first_confirmed_entry_fill_at=fill_at,
+        exit_kind=ExitKind.STRATEGY,
+    )
+    after = policy.evaluate(
+        now=fill_at + timedelta(minutes=10), first_confirmed_entry_fill_at=fill_at,
+        exit_kind=ExitKind.STRATEGY,
+    )
+    assert before.reason == "MINIMUM_HOLD_NOT_ELAPSED"
+    assert after.allowed
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", [
+    ExitKind.PROTECTIVE_STOP, ExitKind.TRAILING_STOP, ExitKind.RISK_SAFETY,
+    ExitKind.DAILY_LOSS, ExitKind.MANUAL_CLOSE, ExitKind.CLOSE_ALL,
+    ExitKind.FLATTEN, ExitKind.RECONCILIATION, ExitKind.END_OF_DAY,
+])
+def test_minimum_hold_does_not_block_exempt_exit_kinds(kind):
+    decision = MinimumHoldPolicy(timedelta(days=1)).evaluate(
+        now=datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 1, tzinfo=UTC),
+        first_confirmed_entry_fill_at=datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC),
+        exit_kind=kind,
+    )
+    assert decision.allowed
+
+
+def test_end_of_day_close_is_disabled_by_default():
+    assert SessionPolicy().end_of_day_close_enabled is False

+"""Pure spread and liquidity entry filters over a supplied quote snapshot."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from decimal import Decimal
+from enum import Enum
+from typing import Protocol
+
+__all__ = ["SpreadFilter", "LiquidityFilter", "MarketFilterDecision", "MarketFilterReason"]
+
+_ZERO = Decimal("0")
+_TEN_THOUSAND = Decimal("10000")
+
+
+class MarketFilterReason(str, Enum):
+    SPREAD_TOO_WIDE = "SPREAD_TOO_WIDE"
+    INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY = "INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY"
+    QUOTE_MISSING = "QUOTE_MISSING"
+    QUOTE_STALE = "QUOTE_STALE"
+    QUOTE_CROSSED = "QUOTE_CROSSED"
+    QUOTE_LOCKED = "QUOTE_LOCKED"
+    UNKNOWN_PROVENANCE = "UNKNOWN_PROVENANCE"
+    INVALID_QUOTE = "INVALID_QUOTE"
+
+
+class QuoteSnapshot(Protocol):
+    bid: Decimal
+    ask: Decimal
+    bid_size: Decimal | None
+    ask_size: Decimal | None
+    receive_ts: datetime
+    feed_id: str | None
+    stale: bool
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class SpreadFilter:
+    max_absolute: Decimal | None = None
+    max_basis_points: Decimal | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if self.max_absolute is None and self.max_basis_points is None:
+            raise ValueError("at least one spread maximum is required")
+        _optional_nonnegative(self.max_absolute, "max_absolute")
+        _optional_nonnegative(self.max_basis_points, "max_basis_points")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class LiquidityFilter:
+    minimum_recent_volume: Decimal | None = None
+    minimum_quote_size: Decimal | None = None
+    max_quote_age: timedelta = timedelta(seconds=5)
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if self.minimum_recent_volume is None and self.minimum_quote_size is None:
+            raise ValueError("at least one liquidity minimum is required")
+        _optional_nonnegative(self.minimum_recent_volume, "minimum_recent_volume")
+        _optional_nonnegative(self.minimum_quote_size, "minimum_quote_size")
+        if not isinstance(self.max_quote_age, timedelta) or self.max_quote_age < timedelta(0):
+            raise ValueError("max_quote_age must be a non-negative timedelta")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class MarketFilterDecision:
+    allowed: bool
+    reasons: tuple[MarketFilterReason, ...]
+    evaluated_at: datetime
+    feed_provenance: str | None
+    spread_absolute: Decimal | None = None
+    spread_basis_points: Decimal | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def blocked(self) -> bool:
+        return not self.allowed
+
+    @classmethod
+    def evaluate(
+        cls, *, now: datetime, quote: QuoteSnapshot | None,
+        spread_filter: SpreadFilter | None = None,
+        liquidity_filter: LiquidityFilter | None = None,
+        recent_volume: Decimal | None = None,
+    ) -> "MarketFilterDecision":
+        return _evaluate_market_filters(
+            now=now, quote=quote, spread_filter=spread_filter,
+            liquidity_filter=liquidity_filter, recent_volume=recent_volume,
+        )
+
+
+def _evaluate_market_filters(
+    *, now: datetime, quote: QuoteSnapshot | None, spread_filter: SpreadFilter | None = None,
+    liquidity_filter: LiquidityFilter | None = None, recent_volume: Decimal | None = None,
+) -> MarketFilterDecision:
+    """Evaluate supplied data only; this function never fetches or persists anything."""
+    instant = _utc(now, "now")
+    if spread_filter is not None and not isinstance(spread_filter, SpreadFilter):
+        raise TypeError("spread_filter must be SpreadFilter or None")
+    if liquidity_filter is not None and not isinstance(liquidity_filter, LiquidityFilter):
+        raise TypeError("liquidity_filter must be LiquidityFilter or None")
+    if recent_volume is not None:
+        _nonnegative(recent_volume, "recent_volume")
+    reasons: list[MarketFilterReason] = []
+    provenance = None if quote is None else getattr(quote, "feed_id", None)
+    if quote is None:
+        reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_MISSING)
+    else:
+        if not isinstance(provenance, str) or not provenance.strip():
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.UNKNOWN_PROVENANCE)
+            provenance = None
+        else:
+            provenance = provenance.strip()
+        bid, ask = getattr(quote, "bid", None), getattr(quote, "ask", None)
+        receive_ts = getattr(quote, "receive_ts", None)
+        stale = getattr(quote, "stale", False)
+        if not isinstance(bid, Decimal) or not isinstance(ask, Decimal) or not bid.is_finite() or not ask.is_finite():
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.INVALID_QUOTE)
+        elif bid < _ZERO or ask < _ZERO:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.INVALID_QUOTE)
+        elif bid > ask:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_CROSSED)
+        elif bid == ask:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_LOCKED)
+        if not isinstance(receive_ts, datetime) or receive_ts.tzinfo is None or receive_ts.utcoffset() is None:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_STALE)
+        elif receive_ts.astimezone(timezone.utc) > instant or stale:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_STALE)
+        elif liquidity_filter is not None and instant - receive_ts.astimezone(timezone.utc) > liquidity_filter.max_quote_age:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_STALE)
+        spread_abs = spread_bps = None
+        if isinstance(bid, Decimal) and isinstance(ask, Decimal) and bid.is_finite() and ask.is_finite() and ask > bid and bid >= _ZERO:
+            spread_abs = ask - bid
+            midpoint = (ask + bid) / Decimal("2")
+            if midpoint > _ZERO:
+                spread_bps = spread_abs / midpoint * _TEN_THOUSAND
+            if spread_filter is not None:
+                if spread_filter.max_absolute is not None and spread_abs > spread_filter.max_absolute:
+                    reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.SPREAD_TOO_WIDE)
+                if spread_filter.max_basis_points is not None and (
+                    spread_bps is None or spread_bps > spread_filter.max_basis_points
+                ):
+                    reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.SPREAD_TOO_WIDE)
+        if liquidity_filter is not None:
+            if liquidity_filter.minimum_recent_volume is not None and (
+                recent_volume is None or recent_volume < liquidity_filter.minimum_recent_volume
+            ):
+                reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY)
+            if liquidity_filter.minimum_quote_size is not None:
+                bid_size, ask_size = getattr(quote, "bid_size", None), getattr(quote, "ask_size", None)
+                if (
+                    not isinstance(bid_size, Decimal) or not isinstance(ask_size, Decimal)
+                    or bid_size < liquidity_filter.minimum_quote_size
+                    or ask_size < liquidity_filter.minimum_quote_size
+                ):
+                    reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY)
+    unique_reasons = tuple(dict.fromkeys(reasons))
+    return MarketFilterDecision(
+        allowed=not unique_reasons, reasons=unique_reasons, evaluated_at=instant,
+        feed_provenance=provenance,
+        spread_absolute=spread_abs if quote is not None else None,
+        spread_basis_points=spread_bps if quote is not None else None,
+    )
+
+
+def _nonnegative(value: object, name: str) -> None:
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be Decimal")
+    if not value.is_finite() or value < _ZERO:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite and non-negative")
+
+
+def _optional_nonnegative(value: Decimal | None, name: str) -> None:
+    if value is not None:
+        _nonnegative(value, name)
+
+
+def _utc(value: datetime, name: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be timezone-aware UTC")
+    if value.utcoffset() != timedelta(0):

+"""Pure NYSE session entry and discretionary minimum-hold policies."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from enum import Enum
+
+from mike_trade.scheduling import calendar
+
+__all__ = [
+    "SessionPolicy", "SessionDecision", "EntryCutoffPolicy",
+    "MinimumHoldPolicy", "ExitKind",
+]
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class SessionDecision:
+    allowed: bool
+    reason: str
+    evaluated_at: datetime
+    cutoff_at: datetime | None = None
+    hold_until: datetime | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def blocked(self) -> bool:
+        return not self.allowed
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class EntryCutoffPolicy:
+    """Stop accepting entries this many minutes before the actual session close."""
+
+    minutes_before_close: int = 0
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if isinstance(self.minutes_before_close, bool) or not isinstance(self.minutes_before_close, int):
+            raise TypeError("minutes_before_close must be an integer")
+        if self.minutes_before_close < 0:
+            raise ValueError("minutes_before_close must be non-negative")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class SessionPolicy:
+    """Regular-hours-only entry gate; end-of-day position closing is opt-in metadata."""
+
+    entry_cutoff: EntryCutoffPolicy | None = None
+    regular_hours_only: bool = True
+    end_of_day_close_enabled: bool = False
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if self.entry_cutoff is not None and not isinstance(self.entry_cutoff, EntryCutoffPolicy):
+            raise TypeError("entry_cutoff must be EntryCutoffPolicy or None")
+        if not isinstance(self.regular_hours_only, bool):
+            raise TypeError("regular_hours_only must be bool")
+        if not isinstance(self.end_of_day_close_enabled, bool):
+            raise TypeError("end_of_day_close_enabled must be bool")
+
+    def evaluate(self, now: datetime) -> SessionDecision:
+        instant = _utc(now, "now")
+        status = calendar.session_status(instant)
+        if self.regular_hours_only and status is not calendar.SessionStatus.REGULAR:
+            return SessionDecision(False, "OUTSIDE_REGULAR_HOURS", instant)
+        cutoff_at = None
+        if self.entry_cutoff is not None:
+            local_day = instant.astimezone(calendar.NEW_YORK).date()
+            if status is calendar.SessionStatus.REGULAR:
+                session = calendar.session_for(local_day)
+                cutoff_at = calendar.entry_cutoff(session, self.entry_cutoff.minutes_before_close)
+                if instant >= cutoff_at:
+                    return SessionDecision(False, "ENTRY_CUTOFF_REACHED", instant, cutoff_at)
+        return SessionDecision(True, "ALLOWED", instant, cutoff_at)
+
+
+class ExitKind(str, Enum):
+    STRATEGY = "strategy"
+    PROTECTIVE_STOP = "protective_stop"
+    TRAILING_STOP = "trailing_stop"
+    RISK_SAFETY = "risk_safety"
+    DAILY_LOSS = "daily_loss"
+    MANUAL_CLOSE = "manual_close"
+    CLOSE_ALL = "close_all"
+    FLATTEN = "flatten"
+    RECONCILIATION = "reconciliation"
+    END_OF_DAY = "end_of_day"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class MinimumHoldPolicy:
+    """Hold duration applies only to ordinary strategy SELL exits."""
+
+    minimum_hold: timedelta = timedelta(0)
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not isinstance(self.minimum_hold, timedelta) or self.minimum_hold < timedelta(0):
+            raise ValueError("minimum_hold must be a non-negative timedelta")
+
+    def evaluate(
+        self, *, now: datetime, first_confirmed_entry_fill_at: datetime | None,
+        exit_kind: ExitKind,
+    ) -> SessionDecision:
+        instant = _utc(now, "now")
+        if not isinstance(exit_kind, ExitKind):
+            raise TypeError("exit_kind must be ExitKind")
+        # All non-strategy exits are explicitly exempt from this discretionary policy.
+        if exit_kind is not ExitKind.STRATEGY or self.minimum_hold == timedelta(0):
+            return SessionDecision(True, "ALLOWED", instant)
+        if first_confirmed_entry_fill_at is None:
+            return SessionDecision(False, "NO_CONFIRMED_ENTRY_FILL", instant)
+        filled_at = _utc(first_confirmed_entry_fill_at, "first_confirmed_entry_fill_at")
+        hold_until = filled_at + self.minimum_hold
+        if instant < hold_until:
+            return SessionDecision(False, "MINIMUM_HOLD_NOT_ELAPSED", instant, hold_until=hold_until)
+        return SessionDecision(True, "ALLOWED", instant, hold_until=hold_until)
+
+
+def _utc(value: datetime, name: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a timezone-aware UTC datetime")
+    if value.utcoffset() != timedelta(0):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must use UTC")
+    return value.astimezone(timezone.utc)

+from dataclasses import dataclass

+

+    LiquidityFilter,
+    MarketFilterDecision,
+    MarketFilterReason,
+    SpreadFilter,
+)
+from mike_trade.risk.session_policy import (
+    EntryCutoffPolicy,
+    ExitKind,
+    MinimumHoldPolicy,
+    SessionPolicy,
+)
+
+UTC = timezone.utc
+
+

+class Quote:
+    bid: Decimal = Decimal("99.90")
+    ask: Decimal = Decimal("100.10")
+    bid_size: Decimal | None = Decimal("20")
+    ask_size: Decimal | None = Decimal("20")
+    receive_ts: datetime = datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
+    feed_id: str | None = "IEX"
+    stale: bool = False
+
+
+def test_regular_hours_gate_uses_new_york_dst_session_boundaries():
+    policy = SessionPolicy()
+    # DST began on March 9, 2025; Monday's regular open is now 13:30 UTC.
+    assert not policy.evaluate(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 13, 29, tzinfo=UTC)).allowed
+    assert policy.evaluate(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 13, 30, tzinfo=UTC)).allowed
+    assert not policy.evaluate(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 20, 0, tzinfo=UTC)).allowed
+
+
+def test_cutoff_uses_actual_early_close_time():
+    policy = SessionPolicy(entry_cutoff=EntryCutoffPolicy(30))
+    # Nov 28, 2025 is the day after Thanksgiving and closes at 13:00 ET.
+    assert policy.evaluate(datetime(2025, 11, 28, 17, 29, tzinfo=UTC)).allowed
+    blocked = policy.evaluate(datetime(2025, 11, 28, 17, 30, tzinfo=UTC))
+    assert blocked.reason == "ENTRY_CUTOFF_REACHED"
+    assert blocked.cutoff_at == datetime(2025, 11, 28, 17, 30, tzinfo=UTC)
+
+
+def test_market_filter_blocks_absolute_and_basis_point_spread():
+    now = datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
+    quote = Quote()
+    absolute = MarketFilterDecision.evaluate(
+        now=now, quote=quote, spread_filter=SpreadFilter(max_absolute=Decimal("0.10"))
+    )
+    assert MarketFilterReason.SPREAD_TOO_WIDE in absolute.reasons
+    bps = MarketFilterDecision.evaluate(
+        now=now, quote=quote, spread_filter=SpreadFilter(max_basis_points=Decimal("10"))
+    )
+    assert MarketFilterReason.SPREAD_TOO_WIDE in bps.reasons
+
+
+def test_market_filter_blocks_insufficient_liquidity_and_preserves_feed():
+    now = datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
+    decision = MarketFilterDecision.evaluate(
+        now=now, quote=Quote(),
+        liquidity_filter=LiquidityFilter(
+            minimum_recent_volume=Decimal("1000"), minimum_quote_size=Decimal("30")
+        ),
+        recent_volume=Decimal("999"),
+    )
+    assert MarketFilterReason.INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY in decision.reasons
+    assert decision.feed_provenance == "IEX"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("quote", "now", "reason"),
+    [
+        (None, datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC), MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_MISSING),
+        (Quote(receive_ts=datetime(2025, 3, 10, 13, 59, tzinfo=UTC)), datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC), MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_STALE),

+        (Quote(bid=Decimal("100.1"), ask=Decimal("100.1")), datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC), MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_LOCKED),
+        (Quote(feed_id=None), datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC), MarketFilterReason.UNKNOWN_PROVENANCE),

+)
+def test_market_filter_fails_closed_for_unusable_quote(quote, now, reason):
+    decision = MarketFilterDecision.evaluate(
+        now=now, quote=quote,
+        liquidity_filter=LiquidityFilter(minimum_quote_size=Decimal("1")),
+    )
+    assert not decision.allowed
+    assert reason in decision.reasons
+
+
+def test_minimum_hold_blocks_strategy_exit_until_elapsed():
+    policy = MinimumHoldPolicy(timedelta(minutes=10))
+    fill_at = datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
+    before = policy.evaluate(
+        now=fill_at + timedelta(minutes=9), first_confirmed_entry_fill_at=fill_at,

+        exit_kind=ExitKind.STRATEGY,
+    )
+    assert before.reason == "MINIMUM_HOLD_NOT_ELAPSED"
+    assert after.allowed
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", [
+    ExitKind.PROTECTIVE_STOP, ExitKind.TRAILING_STOP, ExitKind.RISK_SAFETY,
+    ExitKind.DAILY_LOSS, ExitKind.MANUAL_CLOSE, ExitKind.CLOSE_ALL,
+    ExitKind.FLATTEN, ExitKind.RECONCILIATION, ExitKind.END_OF_DAY,
+])
+def test_minimum_hold_does_not_block_exempt_exit_kinds(kind):
+    decision = MinimumHoldPolicy(timedelta(days=1)).evaluate(
+        now=datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 1, tzinfo=UTC),
+        first_confirmed_entry_fill_at=datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC),
+        exit_kind=kind,
+    )
+    assert decision.allowed
+
+

+    assert SessionPolicy().end_of_day_close_enabled is False

+"""Pure spread and liquidity entry filters over a supplied quote snapshot."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from decimal import Decimal
+from enum import Enum
+from typing import Protocol
+
+__all__ = ["SpreadFilter", "LiquidityFilter", "MarketFilterDecision", "MarketFilterReason"]
+
+_ZERO = Decimal("0")
+_TEN_THOUSAND = Decimal("10000")
+
+
+class MarketFilterReason(str, Enum):
+    SPREAD_TOO_WIDE = "SPREAD_TOO_WIDE"
+    INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY = "INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY"
+    QUOTE_MISSING = "QUOTE_MISSING"
+    QUOTE_STALE = "QUOTE_STALE"
+    QUOTE_CROSSED = "QUOTE_CROSSED"
+    QUOTE_LOCKED = "QUOTE_LOCKED"
+    UNKNOWN_PROVENANCE = "UNKNOWN_PROVENANCE"
+    INVALID_QUOTE = "INVALID_QUOTE"
+
+
+class QuoteSnapshot(Protocol):
+    bid: Decimal
+    ask: Decimal
+    bid_size: Decimal | None
+    ask_size: Decimal | None
+    receive_ts: datetime
+    feed_id: str | None
+    stale: bool
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class SpreadFilter:
+    max_absolute: Decimal | None = None
+    max_basis_points: Decimal | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if self.max_absolute is None and self.max_basis_points is None:
+            raise ValueError("at least one spread maximum is required")
+        _optional_nonnegative(self.max_absolute, "max_absolute")
+        _optional_nonnegative(self.max_basis_points, "max_basis_points")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class LiquidityFilter:
+    minimum_recent_volume: Decimal | None = None
+    minimum_quote_size: Decimal | None = None
+    max_quote_age: timedelta = timedelta(seconds=5)
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if self.minimum_recent_volume is None and self.minimum_quote_size is None:
+            raise ValueError("at least one liquidity minimum is required")
+        _optional_nonnegative(self.minimum_recent_volume, "minimum_recent_volume")
+        _optional_nonnegative(self.minimum_quote_size, "minimum_quote_size")
+        if not isinstance(self.max_quote_age, timedelta) or self.max_quote_age < timedelta(0):
+            raise ValueError("max_quote_age must be a non-negative timedelta")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class MarketFilterDecision:
+    allowed: bool
+    reasons: tuple[MarketFilterReason, ...]
+    evaluated_at: datetime
+    feed_provenance: str | None
+    spread_absolute: Decimal | None = None
+    spread_basis_points: Decimal | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def blocked(self) -> bool:
+        return not self.allowed
+
+    @classmethod
+    def evaluate(
+        cls, *, now: datetime, quote: QuoteSnapshot | None,
+        spread_filter: SpreadFilter | None = None,
+        liquidity_filter: LiquidityFilter | None = None,
+        recent_volume: Decimal | None = None,
+    ) -> "MarketFilterDecision":
+        return _evaluate_market_filters(
+            now=now, quote=quote, spread_filter=spread_filter,
+            liquidity_filter=liquidity_filter, recent_volume=recent_volume,
+        )
+
+
+def _evaluate_market_filters(
+    *, now: datetime, quote: QuoteSnapshot | None, spread_filter: SpreadFilter | None = None,
+    liquidity_filter: LiquidityFilter | None = None, recent_volume: Decimal | None = None,
+) -> MarketFilterDecision:
+    """Evaluate supplied data only; this function never fetches or persists anything."""
+    instant = _utc(now, "now")
+    if spread_filter is not None and not isinstance(spread_filter, SpreadFilter):
+        raise TypeError("spread_filter must be SpreadFilter or None")
+    if liquidity_filter is not None and not isinstance(liquidity_filter, LiquidityFilter):
+        raise TypeError("liquidity_filter must be LiquidityFilter or None")
+    if recent_volume is not None:
+        _nonnegative(recent_volume, "recent_volume")
+    reasons: list[MarketFilterReason] = []
+    provenance = None if quote is None else getattr(quote, "feed_id", None)
+    if quote is None:
+        reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_MISSING)
+    else:
+        if not isinstance(provenance, str) or not provenance.strip():
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.UNKNOWN_PROVENANCE)
+            provenance = None
+        else:
+            provenance = provenance.strip()
+        bid, ask = getattr(quote, "bid", None), getattr(quote, "ask", None)
+        receive_ts = getattr(quote, "receive_ts", None)
+        stale = getattr(quote, "stale", False)
+        if not isinstance(bid, Decimal) or not isinstance(ask, Decimal) or not bid.is_finite() or not ask.is_finite():
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.INVALID_QUOTE)
+        elif bid < _ZERO or ask < _ZERO:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.INVALID_QUOTE)
+        elif bid > ask:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_CROSSED)
+        elif bid == ask:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_LOCKED)
+        if not isinstance(receive_ts, datetime) or receive_ts.tzinfo is None or receive_ts.utcoffset() is None:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_STALE)
+        elif receive_ts.astimezone(timezone.utc) > instant or stale:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_STALE)
+        elif liquidity_filter is not None and instant - receive_ts.astimezone(timezone.utc) > liquidity_filter.max_quote_age:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_STALE)
+        spread_abs = spread_bps = None
+        if isinstance(bid, Decimal) and isinstance(ask, Decimal) and bid.is_finite() and ask.is_finite() and ask > bid and bid >= _ZERO:
+            spread_abs = ask - bid
+            midpoint = (ask + bid) / Decimal("2")
+            if midpoint > _ZERO:
+                spread_bps = spread_abs / midpoint * _TEN_THOUSAND
+            if spread_filter is not None:
+                if spread_filter.max_absolute is not None and spread_abs > spread_filter.max_absolute:
+                    reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.SPREAD_TOO_WIDE)
+                if spread_filter.max_basis_points is not None and (
+                    spread_bps is None or spread_bps > spread_filter.max_basis_points
+                ):
+                    reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.SPREAD_TOO_WIDE)
+        if liquidity_filter is not None:
+            if liquidity_filter.minimum_recent_volume is not None and (
+                recent_volume is None or recent_volume < liquidity_filter.minimum_recent_volume
+            ):
+                reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY)
+            if liquidity_filter.minimum_quote_size is not None:
+                bid_size, ask_size = getattr(quote, "bid_size", None), getattr(quote, "ask_size", None)
+                if (
+                    not isinstance(bid_size, Decimal) or not isinstance(ask_size, Decimal)
+                    or bid_size < liquidity_filter.minimum_quote_size
+                    or ask_size < liquidity_filter.minimum_quote_size
+                ):
+                    reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY)
+    unique_reasons = tuple(dict.fromkeys(reasons))
+    return MarketFilterDecision(
+        allowed=not unique_reasons, reasons=unique_reasons, evaluated_at=instant,
+        feed_provenance=provenance,
+        spread_absolute=spread_abs if quote is not None else None,
+        spread_basis_points=spread_bps if quote is not None else None,
+    )
+
+
+def _nonnegative(value: object, name: str) -> None:
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be Decimal")
+    if not value.is_finite() or value < _ZERO:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite and non-negative")
+
+
+def _optional_nonnegative(value: Decimal | None, name: str) -> None:
+    if value is not None:
+        _nonnegative(value, name)
+
+
+def _utc(value: datetime, name: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be timezone-aware UTC")
+    if value.utcoffset() != timedelta(0):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must use UTC")
+    return value.astimezone(timezone.utc)

+                cutoff_at = calendar.entry_cutoff(session, self.entry_cutoff.minutes_before_close)
+                if instant >= cutoff_at:
+                    return SessionDecision(False, "ENTRY_CUTOFF_REACHED", instant, cutoff_at)
+        return SessionDecision(True, "ALLOWED", instant, cutoff_at)
+
+
+class ExitKind(str, Enum):
+    STRATEGY = "strategy"
+    PROTECTIVE_STOP = "protective_stop"
+    TRAILING_STOP = "trailing_stop"
+    RISK_SAFETY = "risk_safety"
+    DAILY_LOSS = "daily_loss"
+    MANUAL_CLOSE = "manual_close"
+    CLOSE_ALL = "close_all"
+    FLATTEN = "flatten"
+    RECONCILIATION = "reconciliation"
+    END_OF_DAY = "end_of_day"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class MinimumHoldPolicy:
+    """Hold duration applies only to ordinary strategy SELL exits."""
+
+    minimum_hold: timedelta = timedelta(0)
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not isinstance(self.minimum_hold, timedelta) or self.minimum_hold < timedelta(0):
+            raise ValueError("minimum_hold must be a non-negative timedelta")
+
+    def evaluate(
+        self, *, now: datetime, first_confirmed_entry_fill_at: datetime | None,
+        exit_kind: ExitKind,
+    ) -> SessionDecision:
+        instant = _utc(now, "now")
+        if not isinstance(exit_kind, ExitKind):
+            raise TypeError("exit_kind must be ExitKind")
+        # All non-strategy exits are explicitly exempt from this discretionary policy.
+        if exit_kind is not ExitKind.STRATEGY or self.minimum_hold == timedelta(0):
+            return SessionDecision(True, "ALLOWED", instant)
+        if first_confirmed_entry_fill_at is None:
+            return SessionDecision(False, "NO_CONFIRMED_ENTRY_FILL", instant)
+        filled_at = _utc(first_confirmed_entry_fill_at, "first_confirmed_entry_fill_at")
+        hold_until = filled_at + self.minimum_hold
+        if instant < hold_until:
+            return SessionDecision(False, "MINIMUM_HOLD_NOT_ELAPSED", instant, hold_until=hold_until)
+        return SessionDecision(True, "ALLOWED", instant, hold_until=hold_until)
+
+
+def _utc(value: datetime, name: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a timezone-aware UTC datetime")
+    if value.utcoffset() != timedelta(0):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must use UTC")
+    return value.astimezone(timezone.utc)

+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from decimal import Decimal
+
+import pytest
+
+from mike_trade.risk.market_filters import (
+    LiquidityFilter,
+    MarketFilterDecision,
+    MarketFilterReason,
+    SpreadFilter,
+)
+from mike_trade.risk.session_policy import (
+    EntryCutoffPolicy,
+    ExitKind,
+    MinimumHoldPolicy,
+    SessionPolicy,
+)
+
+UTC = timezone.utc
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True)
+class Quote:
+    bid: Decimal = Decimal("99.90")
+    ask: Decimal = Decimal("100.10")
+    bid_size: Decimal | None = Decimal("20")
+    ask_size: Decimal | None = Decimal("20")
+    receive_ts: datetime = datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
+    feed_id: str | None = "IEX"
+    stale: bool = False
+
+
+def test_regular_hours_gate_uses_new_york_dst_session_boundaries():
+    policy = SessionPolicy()
+    # DST began on March 9, 2025; Monday's regular open is now 13:30 UTC.
+    assert not policy.evaluate(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 13, 29, tzinfo=UTC)).allowed
+    assert policy.evaluate(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 13, 30, tzinfo=UTC)).allowed
+    assert not policy.evaluate(datetime(2025, 3, 10, 20, 0, tzinfo=UTC)).allowed
+
+
+def test_cutoff_uses_actual_early_close_time():
+    policy = SessionPolicy(entry_cutoff=EntryCutoffPolicy(30))
+    # Nov 28, 2025 is the day after Thanksgiving and closes at 13:00 ET.
+    assert policy.evaluate(datetime(2025, 11, 28, 17, 29, tzinfo=UTC)).allowed
+    blocked = policy.evaluate(datetime(2025, 11, 28, 17, 30, tzinfo=UTC))
+    assert blocked.reason == "ENTRY_CUTOFF_REACHED"
+    assert blocked.cutoff_at == datetime(2025, 11, 28, 17, 30, tzinfo=UTC)
+
+
+def test_market_filter_blocks_absolute_and_basis_point_spread():
+    now = datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
+    quote = Quote()
+    absolute = MarketFilterDecision.evaluate(
+        now=now, quote=quote, spread_filter=SpreadFilter(max_absolute=Decimal("0.10"))
+    )
+    assert MarketFilterReason.SPREAD_TOO_WIDE in absolute.reasons
+    bps = MarketFilterDecision.evaluate(
+        now=now, quote=quote, spread_filter=SpreadFilter(max_basis_points=Decimal("10"))
+    )
+    assert MarketFilterReason.SPREAD_TOO_WIDE in bps.reasons
+
+
+def test_market_filter_blocks_insufficient_liquidity_and_preserves_feed():
+    now = datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
+    decision = MarketFilterDecision.evaluate(
+        now=now, quote=Quote(),
+        liquidity_filter=LiquidityFilter(
+            minimum_recent_volume=Decimal("1000"), minimum_quote_size=Decimal("30")
+        ),
+        recent_volume=Decimal("999"),
+    )
+    assert MarketFilterReason.INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY in decision.reasons
+    assert decision.feed_provenance == "IEX"
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize(
+    ("quote", "now", "reason"),
+    [
+        (None, datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC), MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_MISSING),
+        (Quote(receive_ts=datetime(2025, 3, 10, 13, 59, tzinfo=UTC)), datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC), MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_STALE),
+        (Quote(bid=Decimal("100.2"), ask=Decimal("100.1")), datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC), MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_CROSSED),
+        (Quote(bid=Decimal("100.1"), ask=Decimal("100.1")), datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC), MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_LOCKED),
+        (Quote(feed_id=None), datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC), MarketFilterReason.UNKNOWN_PROVENANCE),
+    ],
+)
+def test_market_filter_fails_closed_for_unusable_quote(quote, now, reason):
+    decision = MarketFilterDecision.evaluate(
+        now=now, quote=quote,
+        liquidity_filter=LiquidityFilter(minimum_quote_size=Decimal("1")),
+    )
+    assert not decision.allowed
+    assert reason in decision.reasons
+
+
+def test_minimum_hold_blocks_strategy_exit_until_elapsed():
+    policy = MinimumHoldPolicy(timedelta(minutes=10))
+    fill_at = datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC)
+    before = policy.evaluate(
+        now=fill_at + timedelta(minutes=9), first_confirmed_entry_fill_at=fill_at,
+        exit_kind=ExitKind.STRATEGY,
+    )
+    after = policy.evaluate(
+        now=fill_at + timedelta(minutes=10), first_confirmed_entry_fill_at=fill_at,
+        exit_kind=ExitKind.STRATEGY,
+    )
+    assert before.reason == "MINIMUM_HOLD_NOT_ELAPSED"
+    assert after.allowed
+
+
+@pytest.mark.parametrize("kind", [
+    ExitKind.PROTECTIVE_STOP, ExitKind.TRAILING_STOP, ExitKind.RISK_SAFETY,
+    ExitKind.DAILY_LOSS, ExitKind.MANUAL_CLOSE, ExitKind.CLOSE_ALL,
+    ExitKind.FLATTEN, ExitKind.RECONCILIATION, ExitKind.END_OF_DAY,
+])
+def test_minimum_hold_does_not_block_exempt_exit_kinds(kind):
+    decision = MinimumHoldPolicy(timedelta(days=1)).evaluate(
+        now=datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 1, tzinfo=UTC),
+        first_confirmed_entry_fill_at=datetime(2025, 3, 10, 14, 0, tzinfo=UTC),
+        exit_kind=kind,
+    )
+    assert decision.allowed
+
+
+def test_end_of_day_close_is_disabled_by_default():
+    assert SessionPolicy().end_of_day_close_enabled is False

+"""Pure spread and liquidity entry filters over a supplied quote snapshot."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from decimal import Decimal
+from enum import Enum
+from typing import Protocol
+
+__all__ = ["SpreadFilter", "LiquidityFilter", "MarketFilterDecision", "MarketFilterReason"]
+
+_ZERO = Decimal("0")
+_TEN_THOUSAND = Decimal("10000")
+
+
+class MarketFilterReason(str, Enum):
+    SPREAD_TOO_WIDE = "SPREAD_TOO_WIDE"
+    INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY = "INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY"
+    QUOTE_MISSING = "QUOTE_MISSING"
+    QUOTE_STALE = "QUOTE_STALE"
+    QUOTE_CROSSED = "QUOTE_CROSSED"
+    QUOTE_LOCKED = "QUOTE_LOCKED"
+    UNKNOWN_PROVENANCE = "UNKNOWN_PROVENANCE"
+    INVALID_QUOTE = "INVALID_QUOTE"
+
+
+class QuoteSnapshot(Protocol):
+    bid: Decimal
+    ask: Decimal
+    bid_size: Decimal | None
+    ask_size: Decimal | None
+    receive_ts: datetime
+    feed_id: str | None
+    stale: bool
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class SpreadFilter:
+    max_absolute: Decimal | None = None
+    max_basis_points: Decimal | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if self.max_absolute is None and self.max_basis_points is None:
+            raise ValueError("at least one spread maximum is required")
+        _optional_nonnegative(self.max_absolute, "max_absolute")
+        _optional_nonnegative(self.max_basis_points, "max_basis_points")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class LiquidityFilter:
+    minimum_recent_volume: Decimal | None = None
+    minimum_quote_size: Decimal | None = None
+    max_quote_age: timedelta = timedelta(seconds=5)
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if self.minimum_recent_volume is None and self.minimum_quote_size is None:
+            raise ValueError("at least one liquidity minimum is required")
+        _optional_nonnegative(self.minimum_recent_volume, "minimum_recent_volume")
+        _optional_nonnegative(self.minimum_quote_size, "minimum_quote_size")
+        if not isinstance(self.max_quote_age, timedelta) or self.max_quote_age < timedelta(0):
+            raise ValueError("max_quote_age must be a non-negative timedelta")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class MarketFilterDecision:
+    allowed: bool
+    reasons: tuple[MarketFilterReason, ...]
+    evaluated_at: datetime
+    feed_provenance: str | None
+    spread_absolute: Decimal | None = None
+    spread_basis_points: Decimal | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def blocked(self) -> bool:
+        return not self.allowed
+
+    @classmethod
+    def evaluate(
+        cls, *, now: datetime, quote: QuoteSnapshot | None,
+        spread_filter: SpreadFilter | None = None,
+        liquidity_filter: LiquidityFilter | None = None,
+        recent_volume: Decimal | None = None,
+    ) -> "MarketFilterDecision":
+        return _evaluate_market_filters(
+            now=now, quote=quote, spread_filter=spread_filter,
+            liquidity_filter=liquidity_filter, recent_volume=recent_volume,
+        )
+
+
+def _evaluate_market_filters(
+    *, now: datetime, quote: QuoteSnapshot | None, spread_filter: SpreadFilter | None = None,
+    liquidity_filter: LiquidityFilter | None = None, recent_volume: Decimal | None = None,
+) -> MarketFilterDecision:
+    """Evaluate supplied data only; this function never fetches or persists anything."""
+    instant = _utc(now, "now")
+    if spread_filter is not None and not isinstance(spread_filter, SpreadFilter):
+        raise TypeError("spread_filter must be SpreadFilter or None")
+    if liquidity_filter is not None and not isinstance(liquidity_filter, LiquidityFilter):
+        raise TypeError("liquidity_filter must be LiquidityFilter or None")
+    if recent_volume is not None:
+        _nonnegative(recent_volume, "recent_volume")
+    reasons: list[MarketFilterReason] = []
+    provenance = None if quote is None else getattr(quote, "feed_id", None)
+    if quote is None:
+        reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_MISSING)
+    else:
+        if not isinstance(provenance, str) or not provenance.strip():
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.UNKNOWN_PROVENANCE)
+            provenance = None
+        else:
+            provenance = provenance.strip()
+        bid, ask = getattr(quote, "bid", None), getattr(quote, "ask", None)
+        receive_ts = getattr(quote, "receive_ts", None)
+        stale = getattr(quote, "stale", False)
+        if not isinstance(bid, Decimal) or not isinstance(ask, Decimal) or not bid.is_finite() or not ask.is_finite():
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.INVALID_QUOTE)
+        elif bid < _ZERO or ask < _ZERO:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.INVALID_QUOTE)
+        elif bid > ask:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_CROSSED)
+        elif bid == ask:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_LOCKED)
+        if not isinstance(receive_ts, datetime) or receive_ts.tzinfo is None or receive_ts.utcoffset() is None:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_STALE)
+        elif receive_ts.astimezone(timezone.utc) > instant or stale:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_STALE)
+        elif liquidity_filter is not None and instant - receive_ts.astimezone(timezone.utc) > liquidity_filter.max_quote_age:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_STALE)
+        spread_abs = spread_bps = None
+        if isinstance(bid, Decimal) and isinstance(ask, Decimal) and bid.is_finite() and ask.is_finite() and ask > bid and bid >= _ZERO:
+            spread_abs = ask - bid
+            midpoint = (ask + bid) / Decimal("2")
+            if midpoint > _ZERO:
+                spread_bps = spread_abs / midpoint * _TEN_THOUSAND
+            if spread_filter is not None:
+                if spread_filter.max_absolute is not None and spread_abs > spread_filter.max_absolute:
+                    reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.SPREAD_TOO_WIDE)
+                if spread_filter.max_basis_points is not None and (
+                    spread_bps is None or spread_bps > spread_filter.max_basis_points
+                ):
+                    reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.SPREAD_TOO_WIDE)
+        if liquidity_filter is not None:
+            if liquidity_filter.minimum_recent_volume is not None and (
+                recent_volume is None or recent_volume < liquidity_filter.minimum_recent_volume
+            ):
+                reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY)
+            if liquidity_filter.minimum_quote_size is not None:
+                bid_size, ask_size = getattr(quote, "bid_size", None), getattr(quote, "ask_size", None)
+                if (
+                    not isinstance(bid_size, Decimal) or not isinstance(ask_size, Decimal)
+                    or bid_size < liquidity_filter.minimum_quote_size
+                    or ask_size < liquidity_filter.minimum_quote_size
+                ):
+                    reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY)
+    unique_reasons = tuple(dict.fromkeys(reasons))
+    return MarketFilterDecision(
+        allowed=not unique_reasons, reasons=unique_reasons, evaluated_at=instant,
+        feed_provenance=provenance,
+        spread_absolute=spread_abs if quote is not None else None,
+        spread_basis_points=spread_bps if quote is not None else None,
+    )
+
+
+def _nonnegative(value: object, name: str) -> None:
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be Decimal")
+    if not value.is_finite() or value < _ZERO:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite and non-negative")
+
+
+def _optional_nonnegative(value: Decimal | None, name: str) -> None:
+    if value is not None:
+        _nonnegative(value, name)
+
+
+def _utc(value: datetime, name: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be timezone-aware UTC")
+    if value.utcoffset() != timedelta(0):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must use UTC")
+    return value.astimezone(timezone.utc)

+"""Pure NYSE session entry and discretionary minimum-hold policies."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from enum import Enum
+
+from mike_trade.scheduling import calendar
+
+__all__ = [
+    "SessionPolicy", "SessionDecision", "EntryCutoffPolicy",
+    "MinimumHoldPolicy", "ExitKind",
+]
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class SessionDecision:
+    allowed: bool
+    reason: str
+    evaluated_at: datetime
+    cutoff_at: datetime | None = None
+    hold_until: datetime | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def blocked(self) -> bool:
+        return not self.allowed
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class EntryCutoffPolicy:
+    """Stop accepting entries this many minutes before the actual session close."""
+
+    minutes_before_close: int = 0
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if isinstance(self.minutes_before_close, bool) or not isinstance(self.minutes_before_close, int):
+            raise TypeError("minutes_before_close must be an integer")
+        if self.minutes_before_close < 0:
+            raise ValueError("minutes_before_close must be non-negative")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class SessionPolicy:
+    """Regular-hours-only entry gate; end-of-day position closing is opt-in metadata."""
+
+    entry_cutoff: EntryCutoffPolicy | None = None
+    regular_hours_only: bool = True
+    end_of_day_close_enabled: bool = False
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if self.entry_cutoff is not None and not isinstance(self.entry_cutoff, EntryCutoffPolicy):
+            raise TypeError("entry_cutoff must be EntryCutoffPolicy or None")
+        if not isinstance(self.regular_hours_only, bool):
+            raise TypeError("regular_hours_only must be bool")
+        if not isinstance(self.end_of_day_close_enabled, bool):
+            raise TypeError("end_of_day_close_enabled must be bool")
+
+    def evaluate(self, now: datetime) -> SessionDecision:
+        instant = _utc(now, "now")
+        status = calendar.session_status(instant)
+        if self.regular_hours_only and status is not calendar.SessionStatus.REGULAR:
+            return SessionDecision(False, "OUTSIDE_REGULAR_HOURS", instant)
+        cutoff_at = None
+        if self.entry_cutoff is not None:
+            local_day = instant.astimezone(calendar.NEW_YORK).date()
+            if status is calendar.SessionStatus.REGULAR:
+                session = calendar.session_for(local_day)
+                cutoff_at = calendar.entry_cutoff(session, self.entry_cutoff.minutes_before_close)
+                if instant >= cutoff_at:
+                    return SessionDecision(False, "ENTRY_CUTOFF_REACHED", instant, cutoff_at)
+        return SessionDecision(True, "ALLOWED", instant, cutoff_at)
+
+
+class ExitKind(str, Enum):
+    STRATEGY = "strategy"
+    PROTECTIVE_STOP = "protective_stop"
+    TRAILING_STOP = "trailing_stop"
+    RISK_SAFETY = "risk_safety"
+    DAILY_LOSS = "daily_loss"
+    MANUAL_CLOSE = "manual_close"
+    CLOSE_ALL = "close_all"
+    FLATTEN = "flatten"
+    RECONCILIATION = "reconciliation"
+    END_OF_DAY = "end_of_day"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class MinimumHoldPolicy:
+    """Hold duration applies only to ordinary strategy SELL exits."""
+
+    minimum_hold: timedelta = timedelta(0)
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not isinstance(self.minimum_hold, timedelta) or self.minimum_hold < timedelta(0):
+            raise ValueError("minimum_hold must be a non-negative timedelta")
+
+    def evaluate(
+        self, *, now: datetime, first_confirmed_entry_fill_at: datetime | None,
+        exit_kind: ExitKind,
+    ) -> SessionDecision:
+        instant = _utc(now, "now")
+        if not isinstance(exit_kind, ExitKind):
+            raise TypeError("exit_kind must be ExitKind")
+        # All non-strategy exits are explicitly exempt from this discretionary policy.
+        if exit_kind is not ExitKind.STRATEGY or self.minimum_hold == timedelta(0):
+            return SessionDecision(True, "ALLOWED", instant)
+        if first_confirmed_entry_fill_at is None:
+            return SessionDecision(False, "NO_CONFIRMED_ENTRY_FILL", instant)
+        filled_at = _utc(first_confirmed_entry_fill_at, "first_confirmed_entry_fill_at")
+        hold_until = filled_at + self.minimum_hold
+        if instant < hold_until:
+            return SessionDecision(False, "MINIMUM_HOLD_NOT_ELAPSED", instant, hold_until=hold_until)
+        return SessionDecision(True, "ALLOWED", instant, hold_until=hold_until)
+
+
+def _utc(value: datetime, name: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a timezone-aware UTC datetime")
+    if value.utcoffset() != timedelta(0):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must use UTC")
+    return value.astimezone(timezone.utc)

+"""Pure spread and liquidity entry filters over a supplied quote snapshot."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from decimal import Decimal
+from enum import Enum
+from typing import Protocol
+
+__all__ = ["SpreadFilter", "LiquidityFilter", "MarketFilterDecision", "MarketFilterReason"]
+
+_ZERO = Decimal("0")
+_TEN_THOUSAND = Decimal("10000")
+
+
+class MarketFilterReason(str, Enum):
+    SPREAD_TOO_WIDE = "SPREAD_TOO_WIDE"
+    INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY = "INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY"
+    QUOTE_MISSING = "QUOTE_MISSING"
+    QUOTE_STALE = "QUOTE_STALE"
+    QUOTE_CROSSED = "QUOTE_CROSSED"
+    QUOTE_LOCKED = "QUOTE_LOCKED"
+    UNKNOWN_PROVENANCE = "UNKNOWN_PROVENANCE"
+    INVALID_QUOTE = "INVALID_QUOTE"
+
+
+class QuoteSnapshot(Protocol):
+    bid: Decimal
+    ask: Decimal
+    bid_size: Decimal | None
+    ask_size: Decimal | None
+    receive_ts: datetime
+    feed_id: str | None
+    stale: bool
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class SpreadFilter:
+    max_absolute: Decimal | None = None
+    max_basis_points: Decimal | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if self.max_absolute is None and self.max_basis_points is None:
+            raise ValueError("at least one spread maximum is required")
+        _optional_nonnegative(self.max_absolute, "max_absolute")
+        _optional_nonnegative(self.max_basis_points, "max_basis_points")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class LiquidityFilter:
+    minimum_recent_volume: Decimal | None = None
+    minimum_quote_size: Decimal | None = None
+    max_quote_age: timedelta = timedelta(seconds=5)
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if self.minimum_recent_volume is None and self.minimum_quote_size is None:
+            raise ValueError("at least one liquidity minimum is required")
+        _optional_nonnegative(self.minimum_recent_volume, "minimum_recent_volume")
+        _optional_nonnegative(self.minimum_quote_size, "minimum_quote_size")
+        if not isinstance(self.max_quote_age, timedelta) or self.max_quote_age < timedelta(0):
+            raise ValueError("max_quote_age must be a non-negative timedelta")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class MarketFilterDecision:
+    allowed: bool
+    reasons: tuple[MarketFilterReason, ...]
+    evaluated_at: datetime
+    feed_provenance: str | None
+    spread_absolute: Decimal | None = None
+    spread_basis_points: Decimal | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def blocked(self) -> bool:
+        return not self.allowed
+
+    @classmethod
+    def evaluate(
+        cls, *, now: datetime, quote: QuoteSnapshot | None,
+        spread_filter: SpreadFilter | None = None,
+        liquidity_filter: LiquidityFilter | None = None,
+        recent_volume: Decimal | None = None,
+    ) -> "MarketFilterDecision":
+        return _evaluate_market_filters(
+            now=now, quote=quote, spread_filter=spread_filter,
+            liquidity_filter=liquidity_filter, recent_volume=recent_volume,
+        )
+
+
+def _evaluate_market_filters(
+    *, now: datetime, quote: QuoteSnapshot | None, spread_filter: SpreadFilter | None = None,
+    liquidity_filter: LiquidityFilter | None = None, recent_volume: Decimal | None = None,
+) -> MarketFilterDecision:
+    """Evaluate supplied data only; this function never fetches or persists anything."""
+    instant = _utc(now, "now")
+    if spread_filter is not None and not isinstance(spread_filter, SpreadFilter):
+        raise TypeError("spread_filter must be SpreadFilter or None")
+    if liquidity_filter is not None and not isinstance(liquidity_filter, LiquidityFilter):
+        raise TypeError("liquidity_filter must be LiquidityFilter or None")
+    if recent_volume is not None:
+        _nonnegative(recent_volume, "recent_volume")
+    reasons: list[MarketFilterReason] = []
+    provenance = None if quote is None else getattr(quote, "feed_id", None)
+    if quote is None:
+        reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_MISSING)
+    else:
+        if not isinstance(provenance, str) or not provenance.strip():
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.UNKNOWN_PROVENANCE)
+            provenance = None
+        else:
+            provenance = provenance.strip()
+        bid, ask = getattr(quote, "bid", None), getattr(quote, "ask", None)
+        receive_ts = getattr(quote, "receive_ts", None)
+        stale = getattr(quote, "stale", False)
+        if not isinstance(bid, Decimal) or not isinstance(ask, Decimal) or not bid.is_finite() or not ask.is_finite():
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.INVALID_QUOTE)
+        elif bid < _ZERO or ask < _ZERO:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.INVALID_QUOTE)
+        elif bid > ask:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_CROSSED)
+        elif bid == ask:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_LOCKED)
+        if not isinstance(receive_ts, datetime) or receive_ts.tzinfo is None or receive_ts.utcoffset() is None:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_STALE)
+        elif receive_ts.astimezone(timezone.utc) > instant or stale:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_STALE)
+        elif liquidity_filter is not None and instant - receive_ts.astimezone(timezone.utc) > liquidity_filter.max_quote_age:
+            reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.QUOTE_STALE)
+        spread_abs = spread_bps = None
+        if isinstance(bid, Decimal) and isinstance(ask, Decimal) and bid.is_finite() and ask.is_finite() and ask > bid and bid >= _ZERO:
+            spread_abs = ask - bid
+            midpoint = (ask + bid) / Decimal("2")
+            if midpoint > _ZERO:
+                spread_bps = spread_abs / midpoint * _TEN_THOUSAND
+            if spread_filter is not None:
+                if spread_filter.max_absolute is not None and spread_abs > spread_filter.max_absolute:
+                    reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.SPREAD_TOO_WIDE)
+                if spread_filter.max_basis_points is not None and (
+                    spread_bps is None or spread_bps > spread_filter.max_basis_points
+                ):
+                    reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.SPREAD_TOO_WIDE)
+        if liquidity_filter is not None:
+            if liquidity_filter.minimum_recent_volume is not None and (
+                recent_volume is None or recent_volume < liquidity_filter.minimum_recent_volume
+            ):
+                reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY)
+            if liquidity_filter.minimum_quote_size is not None:
+                bid_size, ask_size = getattr(quote, "bid_size", None), getattr(quote, "ask_size", None)
+                if (
+                    not isinstance(bid_size, Decimal) or not isinstance(ask_size, Decimal)
+                    or bid_size < liquidity_filter.minimum_quote_size
+                    or ask_size < liquidity_filter.minimum_quote_size
+                ):
+                    reasons.append(MarketFilterReason.INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY)
+    unique_reasons = tuple(dict.fromkeys(reasons))
+    return MarketFilterDecision(
+        allowed=not unique_reasons, reasons=unique_reasons, evaluated_at=instant,
+        feed_provenance=provenance,
+        spread_absolute=spread_abs if quote is not None else None,
+        spread_basis_points=spread_bps if quote is not None else None,
+    )
+
+
+def _nonnegative(value: object, name: str) -> None:
+    if not isinstance(value, Decimal):
+        raise TypeError(f"{name} must be Decimal")
+    if not value.is_finite() or value < _ZERO:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be finite and non-negative")
+
+
+def _optional_nonnegative(value: Decimal | None, name: str) -> None:
+    if value is not None:
+        _nonnegative(value, name)
+
+
+def _utc(value: datetime, name: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be timezone-aware UTC")
+    if value.utcoffset() != timedelta(0):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must use UTC")
+    return value.astimezone(timezone.utc)

+"""Pure NYSE session entry and discretionary minimum-hold policies."""
+
+from __future__ import annotations
+
+from dataclasses import dataclass
+from datetime import datetime, timedelta, timezone
+from enum import Enum
+
+from mike_trade.scheduling import calendar
+
+__all__ = [
+    "SessionPolicy", "SessionDecision", "EntryCutoffPolicy",
+    "MinimumHoldPolicy", "ExitKind",
+]
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class SessionDecision:
+    allowed: bool
+    reason: str
+    evaluated_at: datetime
+    cutoff_at: datetime | None = None
+    hold_until: datetime | None = None
+
+    @property
+    def blocked(self) -> bool:
+        return not self.allowed
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class EntryCutoffPolicy:
+    """Stop accepting entries this many minutes before the actual session close."""
+
+    minutes_before_close: int = 0
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if isinstance(self.minutes_before_close, bool) or not isinstance(self.minutes_before_close, int):
+            raise TypeError("minutes_before_close must be an integer")
+        if self.minutes_before_close < 0:
+            raise ValueError("minutes_before_close must be non-negative")
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class SessionPolicy:
+    """Regular-hours-only entry gate; end-of-day position closing is opt-in metadata."""
+
+    entry_cutoff: EntryCutoffPolicy | None = None
+    regular_hours_only: bool = True
+    end_of_day_close_enabled: bool = False
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if self.entry_cutoff is not None and not isinstance(self.entry_cutoff, EntryCutoffPolicy):
+            raise TypeError("entry_cutoff must be EntryCutoffPolicy or None")
+        if not isinstance(self.regular_hours_only, bool):
+            raise TypeError("regular_hours_only must be bool")
+        if not isinstance(self.end_of_day_close_enabled, bool):
+            raise TypeError("end_of_day_close_enabled must be bool")
+
+    def evaluate(self, now: datetime) -> SessionDecision:
+        instant = _utc(now, "now")
+        status = calendar.session_status(instant)
+        if self.regular_hours_only and status is not calendar.SessionStatus.REGULAR:
+            return SessionDecision(False, "OUTSIDE_REGULAR_HOURS", instant)
+        cutoff_at = None
+        if self.entry_cutoff is not None:
+            local_day = instant.astimezone(calendar.NEW_YORK).date()
+            if status is calendar.SessionStatus.REGULAR:
+                session = calendar.session_for(local_day)
+                cutoff_at = calendar.entry_cutoff(session, self.entry_cutoff.minutes_before_close)
+                if instant >= cutoff_at:
+                    return SessionDecision(False, "ENTRY_CUTOFF_REACHED", instant, cutoff_at)
+        return SessionDecision(True, "ALLOWED", instant, cutoff_at)
+
+
+class ExitKind(str, Enum):
+    STRATEGY = "strategy"
+    PROTECTIVE_STOP = "protective_stop"
+    TRAILING_STOP = "trailing_stop"
+    RISK_SAFETY = "risk_safety"
+    DAILY_LOSS = "daily_loss"
+    MANUAL_CLOSE = "manual_close"
+    CLOSE_ALL = "close_all"
+    FLATTEN = "flatten"
+    RECONCILIATION = "reconciliation"
+    END_OF_DAY = "end_of_day"
+
+
+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class MinimumHoldPolicy:
+    """Hold duration applies only to ordinary strategy SELL exits."""
+
+    minimum_hold: timedelta = timedelta(0)
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if not isinstance(self.minimum_hold, timedelta) or self.minimum_hold < timedelta(0):
+            raise ValueError("minimum_hold must be a non-negative timedelta")
+
+    def evaluate(
+        self, *, now: datetime, first_confirmed_entry_fill_at: datetime | None,
+        exit_kind: ExitKind,
+    ) -> SessionDecision:
+        instant = _utc(now, "now")
+        if not isinstance(exit_kind, ExitKind):
+            raise TypeError("exit_kind must be ExitKind")
+        # All non-strategy exits are explicitly exempt from this discretionary policy.
+        if exit_kind is not ExitKind.STRATEGY or self.minimum_hold == timedelta(0):
+            return SessionDecision(True, "ALLOWED", instant)
+        if first_confirmed_entry_fill_at is None:
+            return SessionDecision(False, "NO_CONFIRMED_ENTRY_FILL", instant)
+        filled_at = _utc(first_confirmed_entry_fill_at, "first_confirmed_entry_fill_at")
+        hold_until = filled_at + self.minimum_hold
+        if instant < hold_until:
+            return SessionDecision(False, "MINIMUM_HOLD_NOT_ELAPSED", instant, hold_until=hold_until)
+        return SessionDecision(True, "ALLOWED", instant, hold_until=hold_until)
+
+
+def _utc(value: datetime, name: str) -> datetime:
+    if not isinstance(value, datetime) or value.tzinfo is None or value.utcoffset() is None:
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must be a timezone-aware UTC datetime")
+    if value.utcoffset() != timedelta(0):
+        raise ValueError(f"{name} must use UTC")
+    return value.astimezone(timezone.utc)

+    INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY = "INSUFFICIENT_LIQUIDITY"

+    QUOTE_STALE = "QUOTE_STALE"

+    INVALID_QUOTE = "INVALID_QUOTE"

+

+    bid: Decimal
+    ask: Decimal
+    bid_size: Decimal | None
+    ask_size: Decimal | None
+    receive_ts: datetime
+    feed_id: str | None
+    stale: bool

+

+class SpreadFilter:
+    max_absolute: Decimal | None = None
+    max_basis_points: Decimal | None = None
+
+    def __post_init__(self) -> None:
+        if self.max_absolute is None and self.max_basis_points is None:
+            raise ValueError("at least one spread maximum is required")
+        _optional_nonnegative(self.max_absolute, "max_absolute")
+        _optional_nonnegative(self.max_basis_points, "max_basis_points")

+@dataclass(frozen=True, slots=True)
+class LiquidityFilter:
